items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: Yeah, we know Lawrence. Yeah, that's his daddy.

ctx.x: Yeah. Now this is Marrera, yeah.

That's John Marrera's daddy. Lawrence Marrera. Yeah, we know Lawrence. Yeah, that's his daddy. How come they call him Moran? I never could figure that out, could you? Billy Moran, they say Moran because they couldn't say Marrera, you know?
Some say Moran, but Billy Morera was his name, see? Yeah.
